snippet.title: AereA | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow SOEDESCO®!
Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco
Website: http://www.soedesco.com/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

SOEDESCO is pleased to announce the return of AereA, the music-themed action RPG now available for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
Originally released by SOEDESCO in 2017, AereA marks the return of one of the company's own original titles to modern consoles.

Set in the fragmented floating world of Aezir, the game invites players to step into the role of one of Great Maestro Guido's disciples on a quest to recover the nine primordial instruments and restore balance to the broken island.
Along the way, players explore diverse islands, complete quests, solve puzzles, battle powerful bosses inspired by musical instruments, and uncover the truth behind the island’s mysterious past. 

Wishlist Links:
🖥️ PlayStation Store:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1470-CUSA08128_00-AEREAUS000000000
🎯 Xbox Store:
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/aerea/9MWWFX03D359/0010
🕹️ Nintendo Switch (eShop): https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/aerea-switch/

Video editor: @juanfranrivero

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
